warnings: Steel trusses: one steel_section per element (spec 6a) is the chord section C-100x50x20x2.3mm; every member size is listed in members[] with its role, since a truss is several sections.
C-section dimension keys d x b x lip x t follow the printed order (spec 6a lipped channel: lip_mm before the thickness; the thickness goes in tw_mm).
The purlin size printed on the elevation is hand-overwritten; the printed note on S-23 (item 5) gives C-75x35x8.5x0.75mm@1.00m and was taken.
Truss panel and height dimensions are element-internal and sit in the grid master unassigned_dimensions; the 2.20 / 10.50 / 2.20 rows are y-axis chains (A-D + eaves).
